name: deepwiki-codebase-wiki
description: Cross-platform DeepWiki workflow with deterministic Mermaid flowchart edge-label repair, regression tests, and separate authoring/render validation.

interface.longDescription: An expanded ChatGPT package for the original DeepWiki Skill. It preserves the original six phases and workflow-runner execution contract, uses native subagents and page-level parallelism when supported, and falls back sequentially otherwise. Version 2.0.6 adds a tested deterministic static lint/repair helper for quoted pipe-delimited flowchart edge labels, while preserving node labels, middle-label syntax, other diagram types, and separate Mermaid.js parser/render outcomes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DeepWiki's original six-phase workflow and preserve the workflow-runner contract. Before writing or validating Mermaid, read references/mermaid-authoring.md and references/mermaid-engine.md. For quoted pipe-delimited flowchart edge labels, use tools/mermaid/mermaid_lint.py: run --check; when safe, write a separate repaired output with --repair --output, review it, merge only generated/AUTOGEN changes, and re-run --check. Never overwrite input or alter manual content. Preserve node-label quotes, middle-label syntax such as A -- "label" --> B, and non-flowchart diagrams. Static authoring lint is not Mermaid parsing. Report authoring_lint as passed/repaired/unresolved separately from renderer passed/failed/not_run. Only actual Mermaid.js parse plus SVG render or Mermaid CLI can produce renderer passed. Run the packaged unittest regression suite when Python is available.
